focus.title: 欧盟拟对华电动汽车加征临时反补贴关税，最高达38.1%
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于6月12日披露拟对中国产电动汽车加征17.4%至38.1%的临时反补贴关税，涉及比亚迪、吉利、上汽等企业。该关税预计7月4日起实施，中欧双方仍在磋商。建议出口企业提前评估供应链调整与价格转嫁方案。
focus.title_en: EU Plans Provisional Anti-Subsidy Tariffs on Chinese EVs, Up to 38.1%
focus.summary_en: On June 12, the European Commission disclosed plans to impose provisional anti-subsidy tariffs of 17.4% to 38.1% on Chinese EVs, affecting BYD, Geely, SAIC, etc. The tariffs are expected to take effect on July 4, with ongoing EU-China consultations. Exporters should assess supply chain adjustments and price pass-through strategies.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：跨境股权转让未获中国外管局登记不导致协议无效
case.summary: SIAC在2026年5月裁决一起中企与新加坡投资者的股权纠纷案，认定未完成中国外汇管理局登记不影响股权转让协议在仲裁中的效力，但登记义务仍须履行。该案提示跨境交易中登记性义务与合同效力的区分。
case.title_en: SIAC Holds: Failure to Register Cross-Border Share Transfer with SAFE Does Not Void Agreement
case.summary_en: In a May 2026 award, the SIAC ruled that the failure to complete SAFE registration for a cross-border share transfer does not invalidate the underlying agreement in arbitration, though the registration obligation remains. The case highlights the distinction between regulatory formalities and contractual validity in cross-border deals.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”机制落地，首批涵盖金融与医疗
policy.summary: 广东省网信办与香港创新科技署于6月20日联合发布大湾区数据跨境流动“白名单”试点指引，明确金融、医疗等领域经备案可便利化出境。企业需建立数据分类分级与合规自评估机制。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.06.20
policy.title_en: GBA Cross-Border Data Flow 'White List' Mechanism Launched, Covering Finance and Healthcare
policy.summary_en: On June 20, the Guangdong Cyberspace Administration and Hong Kong Innovation and Technology Bureau jointly issued a pilot guideline for the GBA data cross-border 'white list', facilitating outbound data flows in finance and healthcare after filing. Enterprises should establish data classification and compliance self-assessment mechanisms.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟反补贴调查下，中国企业应提前构建“原产地+定价”合规防线
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟反补贴调查可能扩展至光伏、风电等领域。建议企业从三方面应对：一是优化供应链，增加非中国原产组件比例；二是建立独立的出口定价与成本核算文档；三是主动申请市场经济待遇。英文以Attorney Qin's view: 开头。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law · 2026.06.24
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Under EU Anti-Subs Probes, Chinese Firms Should Build 'Origin + Pricing' Compliance Defenses
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: EU anti-subsidy investigations may extend to solar, wind sectors. Recommendations: (1) optimize supply chains by increasing non-Chinese-origin components; (2) maintain independent export pricing and cost documentation; (3) proactively apply for Market Economy Treatment.
